meta.policy: Only venue-controlled pages and official PDFs substantiate values. Unknown values are blank and flagged. A guarantee is not a forecast of actual payouts. Ratio = guaranteed pool ÷ buy-in, descriptive only.
meta.formula: Trip cost = entries × buy-ins + nights × true hotel cost; true nightly = rate + resort fee + 13.38% tax (tax applies to rate and resort fee per Bellagio terms; Venetian terms state 13.38% Clark County room tax and 'plus applicable tax' on the fee).

questions.q: What are the exact trip dates and nightly budget/quality floor?
questions.why: Workflow step 1. Rates are date-specific; without dates no checkout total can be confirmed (FL09).
questions.how: Provide arrival/departure dates and a max true nightly cost. The calculator and rate log then compare like-for-like.

questions.answer: Verified across all 37 Venetian structure sheets (2026-11-16): no sheet prints "single entry", a maximum-entry limit, or any re-entry/rebuy/add-on clause. Wynn and Bellagio sheets DO print re-entry clauses, so the distinction is real and documented. A strict freezeout rule still needs written room confirmation before relying on it.
questions.q: Is a one-entry-total freezeout policy required, or is 'no clause printed' acceptable?
questions.why: No official sheet prints a single-entry rule (FL13). Strict policy would remove every event from the list until rooms confirm in writing.
questions.how: Decide the policy; the single-entry toggle filter can enforce either stance.

questions.answer: No official venue publishes door-to-door walking times. Google Maps walking-direction links per hotel–venue pair are provided on the Routes page for verification; recorded values will populate the 30-minute filter.
questions.q: What walking time is acceptable as 'verified' — and from which map service?
questions.why: WalkingMinutes are blank (FL08). The 30-minute limit cannot be applied until values with provenance exist.
questions.how: Verify each route via the provided Google Maps walking links (or Apple Maps) and record minutes + date checked.

questions.q: Which hotel quality ranking should be used?
questions.why: No common official quality metric (star rating) is published by the resorts; quality is currently descriptive only.
questions.how: Pick a criterion (e.g., published room class, user preference, third-party rating with source) and it will be added as a sortable column.

questions.answer: Open — requires a phone call to 702.693.7291. The official page's resume notice is undated (FL05).
questions.q: Are the Bellagio weekly tournaments actually running on the trip dates?
questions.why: The official page carries an undated resume notice (FL05).
questions.how: Call 702.693.7291; record the answer with date and staff name in the questions log.

questions.answer: Answered from the official suite-rate page: a $300+ tournament buy-in per night qualifies (6 hours live cash is the alternative). Most DeepStack buy-ins are ≥$300; on $200-event days (bounty family, RaceDay, Valuetown) the cash-play requirement applies instead. Unplayed nights are repriced to the prevailing rate at checkout.
questions.q: Does the player qualify for the Venetian poker suite rate play requirement?
questions.why: $119/$209 rates require 6 hours cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in per night; otherwise the rate adjusts to prevailing.
questions.how: Confirm the planned schedule meets the requirement per night (the DeepStack buy-ins mostly satisfy the $300+ rule on those days).

questions.q: Is parking needed (rental car) and which hotel's parking policy applies?
questions.why: Parking fees are verified per hotel but blank for ARIA; costs affect true nightly cost.
questions.how: Decide transport; add parking to the trip calculator if needed.
